summary: The Link Management Protocol (LMP) was developed as part of the GMPLS protocol suite to manage traffic engineering links. This document relates LMP's procedures to discovery as defined by the ITU-T, in the context of ASON and transport network terminology, to promote common understanding. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Two groups use different words for similar ideas. This explains how one group's link-checking system lines up with the other's.
